runtime_loud_stored_evidence.stored_loudness_evidence: The controller's goal validation refuses the goal at runtime: "[ros2_control_node-5] [ERROR] [1710412387.951283595] [panda_arm_controller]: Time between points 122 and 123 is not strictly increasing, it is 12.200000 and 12.200000 respectively" followed by "Goal was rejected by server" (https://github.com/moveit/moveit2/issues/2741).

mavros's distance_sensor plugin enforces its configured orientation at run time and refuses the reading with an error: "DS: rangefinder_pub4: received sensor data has different orientation (100) than in config (YAW_45)!" (https://github.com/mavlink/mavros/issues/1688#issuecomment-1007988240); the plugin code returns before publishing on this check ("return;" after the ROS_ERROR_NAMED in handle_distance_sensor). The internal lookup defect also logs "SENSOR: wrong orientation index: 100".

rcl_action refuses the transition and sets an error that rclpy raises: "Failed to update goal state: goal_handle attempted invalid transition from state SUCCEEDED with event CANCEL_GOAL" (https://github.com/ros2/rclpy/issues/790). The exception is only printed at shutdown ("The following exception was never retrieved"), and the client meanwhile gets no cancel response.

The conversion is refused by the type validation of the generated message class, raising "AssertionError: The 'axes' field must be a set or sequence and each value of type 'float' and each float in [-340282299999999994960115009090224128000.000000, 340282299999999994960115009090224128000.000000]" from "/opt/ros/humble/local/lib/python3.10/dist-packages/sensor_msgs/msg/_joy.py", line 165, in axes (https://github.com/RobotWebTools/rosbridge_suite/issues/764). PR #777 describes it as failing "at the msg/idl generated python code's validation step". This is a runtime refusal at message conversion, not a build/connect/activate diagnostic.

Ogre's resource lookup refuses the material assignment and says why: "[rviz2-4] [ERROR] [1649066982.936072797] [rviz2]: Can't assign material Shape22Material to the ManualObject MeshShape_ManualObject0 because this Material does not exist in group General. Have you forgotten to define it in a .material script?" (https://github.com/moveit/moveit2/issues/1164).

The Python interpreter raised AttributeError at the script's first call of the removed symbol; issue title: "'module' object has no attribute 'guided_enable'"; body: "I get the above error when running 'rosrun mavros mavsetp local -p 2 2 2 2' (for example) It's associated to line 40 of the mavsetp script." This is an interpreter diagnostic, not an import-time error and not a ROS-level diagnostic: mavsetp imports mavros.command successfully and fails 0.2 s after its first publish when publish_once() calls enable_offboard() (mavsetp lines 25-42 at 18131c8c).

The refusal is enforced by the ur_driver node's own goal-validation check at goal receipt and reported with an explicit error naming the limit: reporter log '[ERROR] [WallTime: 1412925263.358047] Received a goal with velocities that are higher than 2.000000' (https://robotics.stackexchange.com/questions/63223/path-planning-exceeding-velocity-limits-of-ur5); driver.py at facbe421 lines 736-741: '# Checks that the velocities are withing the specified limits' / 'if not has_limited_velocities(goal_handle.get_goal().trajectory):' / 'message = "Received a goal with velocities that are higher than %f" % max_velocity' / 'rospy.logerr(message)' / 'goal_handle.set_rejected(text=message)' (https://github.com/ros-industrial/universal_robot/blob/facbe421ca2ce22b58d2a941c3228c91c03e542a/ur_driver/src/ur_driver/driver.py). MoveIt's side then logs '[WARNING][ ... ]: Controller handle reports status FAILED' / '[INFO][ ... ]: Execution completed: FAILED'. No build-, connection- or activation-time tooling flags the mismatch; the composition connects normally and the diagnostic appears only when the first goal is submitted (run stage). Marked loud_documented because it is a refusal the driver enforced with a diagnostic, not a silently wrong execution.
